Sandbox_ShoutShockwave_Stagger_tooltip: Shouts can make zombies stagger back. Unlocked at Shout level 2.
Sandbox_ShoutShockwave_Knockdown_tooltip: Shouts can knock zombies down. Unlocked at Shout level 4.
Sandbox_ShoutShockwave_Daze_tooltip: Shouts can make zombies lose their target for a few seconds. Unlocked at Shout level 6.
Sandbox_ShoutShockwave_Damage_tooltip: Shouts can hurt and kill zombies. Unlocked at Shout level 8.
Sandbox_ShoutShockwave_DamageMultiplier_: Multiplies shout damage. At 1, a loud megaphone shout from a skilled survivor kills most normal zombies next to them.
Sandbox_ShoutShockwave_EnduranceMultipli: Multiplies the endurance each shout costs. 0 makes shouting free.
Sandbox_ShoutShockwave_Windows_tooltip: From Shout level 8, shouts break nearby building windows (the louder, the further). Vehicle windows are never affected.
Sandbox_ShoutShockwave_WindowRange_toolt: Multiplies how far shouts break windows. At 1, a Shout level 8 shout breaks every window within about 13 tiles; a skilled megaphone shout, about 20 tiles.
